enum.name: normal
enum.help: Stop at first and last option

param.name: options
param.help: Options as a newline (`\n`) separated string

prop.name: visible_row_count
prop.help: Show this many rows at once

prop.name: bind_value
prop.help: Bind the selected option to a subject

part.name: main
part.help: The background and option list: background and text properties. `text_line_space` sets the row spacing (and the height of the selected band); `anim_duration` sets the scroll animation time.

part.name: selected
part.help: The option in the middle band: text and background properties to highlight the selected row. Can use different font than `main`
